Loss report: gitlab -> forgejo
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/cleanup ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (rules) is not written to the GHA file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/cleanup job.if (condition not expressible in GitHub Actions; job disabled)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci job.if: !github.event.deleted on every job (GitHub Actions runs a push workflow when a branch is deleted and the source starts no run for that; each job condition ends with the guard)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.concurrency: concurrency group per run (Forgejo cancels earlier push and pull_request runs while concurrency is unset; the source had no concurrency, so each run gets its own group)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.finally: job with if: always() that needs every other job
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/cleanup job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/cleanup step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job and GHA does not; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/compile job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/compile step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job and GHA does not; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/cleanup/synth/checkout step.action (printed as an absolute URL; an instance that cannot reach https://github.com needs the URL edited)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/compile/synth/checkout step.action (printed as an absolute URL; an instance that cannot reach https://github.com needs the URL edited)
